requirement_text: The user (LHCP) selects a patient from the list of requested reports.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to select a patient from the list of requested reports, so that I can open that patient's report.
technical_task: Let the LHCP choose a patient from the list of requested reports.
acceptance_criteria: Given the list of requested reports, when the LHCP selects a patient, then that patient's report is opened.
Given the list, when it is displayed, then it contains the patients for whom reports were requested.

requirement_text: The system shall allow curators to create, manage, and map collections.
user_story: As a curator, I want to create, manage and map collections, so that collections are organized and linked.
technical_task: Provide functions for curators to create, manage and map collections.
acceptance_criteria: Given a curator, when the curator creates a collection, then it is saved.
Given an existing collection, when the curator manages or maps it, then the change is saved.
rationale: Role stated: curator. What mapping connects is not stated.

requirement_text: When a button becomes active, it will use animation to get the user's attention.
user_story: As a user, I want a button that becomes active to use animation, so that I notice it.
technical_task: Animate a button when it becomes active.
acceptance_criteria: Given a button that becomes active, when it activates, then an animation is shown on it.
Given a button that is inactive, when it is displayed, then no activation animation is shown.

requirement_text: The timer DDPTimerReset is expired if it runs longer than PPNM_DDPDTReset.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the timer DDPTimerReset to expire when it runs longer than PPNM_DDPDTReset, so that resets are timed.
technical_task: Mark the timer DDPTimerReset as expired when it has run longer than PPNM_DDPDTReset.
acceptance_criteria: Given DDPTimerReset has run longer than PPNM_DDPDTReset, when it is evaluated, then it is expired.
Given DDPTimerReset has not run longer than PPNM_DDPDTReset, when it is evaluated, then it is not expired.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to view their list of classes.
user_story: As a student, I want to view my list of classes, so that I know what I am taking.
technical_task: Show each user their list of classes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with classes, when the user opens the list, then the user's classes are shown.
Given a user with no classes, when the user opens the list, then it is empty.

requirement_text: Select the appropriate encounter from the list on the right to highlight it.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to select an encounter from the list on the right to highlight it, so that I can see which one is chosen.
technical_task: Highlight the encounter the user selects from the list on the right.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of encounters on the right, when the user selects one, then it is highlighted.
Given a highlighted encounter, when the user selects another, then the new one is highlighted instead.

requirement_text: The system shall minimize vertical scrolling by prioritizing top placement of important information and utilize links for less crucial details, and avoid horizontal scrolling altogether.
clarification_questions: What counts as "important" and "less crucial" information?
How much scrolling is acceptable, in screens or pixels?

requirement_text: The FTSS software shall use no more than 5.2 milliseconds of FCP processing time to move the telemetry data to the MPCC/CTC board and complete communication and error handling for the MPCC/CTC board.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS software shall (3.4.2.10) use no more than 5.2 milliseconds of FCP processing time to move the telemetry data to the MPCC/CTC board and complete communication and error handling for the MPCC/CTC board.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS software to use at most 5.2 milliseconds of FCP processing time to move telemetry data to the MPCC/CTC board and handle communication and errors, so that FCP time is bounded.
technical_task: Limit FTSS use of FCP processing time to 5.2 milliseconds for moving telemetry data to the MPCC/CTC board and completing communication and error handling for it.
acceptance_criteria: Given telemetry data is moved to the MPCC/CTC board, when the FCP processing time of the FTSS software is measured, then it is no more than 5.2 milliseconds.
Given communication and error handling for the MPCC/CTC board, when they are included in the measurement, then the total is still no more than 5.2 milliseconds.

requirement_text: The system shall allow archivists to search images by various criteria.
user_story: As an archivist, I want to search images by various criteria, so that I can find them.
technical_task: Offer image search using several criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Given images, when the archivist searches by a criterion, then matching images are listed.
Given several criteria, when the archivist uses them, then the results match them.
rationale: Role stated: archivist. The criteria are not listed.

requirement_text: A patient views a list of his or her referrals.
user_story: As a patient, I want to view a list of my referrals, so that I know where I was sent.
technical_task: Show the patient's referrals in a list.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with referrals, when the patient opens the list, then the referrals are shown.
Given a patient with no referrals, when the patient opens the list, then it is empty.

requirement_text: The system shall allow parents to sign and submit consent forms electronically.
user_story: As a parent, I want to sign and submit consent forms electronically, so that I don't need paper.
technical_task: Provide electronic signing and submission of consent forms.
acceptance_criteria: Given a consent form, when the parent signs it electronically, then the signature is recorded.
Given a signed consent form, when the parent submits it, then it is submitted.

requirement_text: The user interface shall adhere to responsive design principles to ensure optimal viewing and interaction experience across various devices and screen sizes.
user_story: As a user, I want the interface to adapt to various devices and screen sizes, so that it displays well wherever I use it.
technical_task: Apply responsive design principles so the interface adapts to different devices and screen sizes.
acceptance_criteria: Given different screen sizes, when the interface is displayed, then the layout adapts to each.
Given different devices, when the user interacts with the interface, then interaction is possible on each.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Optimal" experience is not measured.

requirement_text: System shall be able to allow customers to apply for loans and check their application status.
user_story: As a customer, I want to apply for loans and check my application status, so that I can follow my application.
technical_task: Provide loan application and application status checking.
acceptance_criteria: Given the loan application form, when the customer submits an application, then it is saved.
Given a submitted application, when the customer checks the status, then the current status is shown.

requirement_text: The system shall support secure communication through message encryption and decryption techniques.
user_story: As a user, I want secure communication through message encryption and decryption, so that my messages stay private.
technical_task: Encrypt outgoing messages and decrypt incoming messages.
acceptance_criteria: Given a message to send, when it is sent, then it is encrypted.
Given an encrypted message received, when it arrives, then it is decrypted for the recipient.

requirement_text: The LMS shall support 500 patrons and handle 1000 requests per minute simultaneously.
user_story: As a librarian, I want the LMS to support 500 patrons and handle 1000 requests per minute simultaneously, so that the library can serve its patrons.
technical_task: Size the LMS for 500 patrons and 1000 requests per minute at the same time.
acceptance_criteria: Given 500 patrons, when they use the LMS, then it supports them.
Given 1000 requests per minute, when they arrive at the same time as the 500 patrons, then the LMS handles them.

requirement_text: The patient or personal health representative clicks an appointment to view more details.
user_story: As a patient, I want to click an appointment to see more details, so that I know what it is about.
technical_task: Make appointments clickable to open their details.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of appointments, when the patient or personal health representative clicks one, then more details are shown.
Given two appointments, when each is clicked, then each shows its own details.
rationale: Role stated: patient or personal health representative.

requirement_text: Here, especially the division of the smallest replaceable unit (module or individual cell) into categories of different installable remaining life classes shall be taken into account.
rationale: The sentence refers to context that is not given and defines no clear behaviour.
clarification_questions: What must the design do with the categories of installable remaining life classes?
What does "here" refer to, and what are the classes?

requirement_text: The user will be able to end the game at any stage of the game.
user_story: As a player, I want to end the game at any stage, so that I can stop whenever I like.
technical_task: Offer an end-game control that works at every stage of the game.
acceptance_criteria: Given a game at any stage, when the user ends it, then the game ends.
Given the game has ended, when the user looks at the screen, then the game is no longer in progress.

requirement_text: If the user forgets their account information, they shall be able to retrieve it via the "forgot your password?" panel.
user_story: As a user who forgot my account information, I want to retrieve it through the forgot your password panel, so that I can sign in again.
technical_task: Add a "forgot your password?" panel for retrieving account information.
acceptance_criteria: Given the "forgot your password?" panel, when the user provides the required information, then the account information can be retrieved.
Given the login screen, when it is displayed, then the "forgot your password?" panel can be reached.
rationale: Role assumed: user who forgot the account information.

requirement_text: System shall present the employee homepage for inputting duty slip information, calculating net bills, and updating car status and customer database.
user_story: As an employee, I want an employee homepage to input duty slip information, calculate net bills and update car status and the customer database, so that I can do my work from one page.
technical_task: Build an employee homepage with functions for duty slip entry, net bill calculation, car status updates and customer database updates.
acceptance_criteria: Given the employee homepage, when an employee enters duty slip information, then it is saved.
Given the employee homepage, when an employee calculates net bills or updates car status and the customer database, then the results are saved.

requirement_text: The Mission Elapsed Time shall be initialized to zero at the first 50 Hz frame.
requirement_text_raw: The Mission Elapsed Time shall [SRS165] be initialized to zero at the first 50 Hz frame.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the Mission Elapsed Time initialized to zero at the first 50 Hz frame, so that elapsed time starts from zero.
technical_task: Set the Mission Elapsed Time to zero when the first 50 Hz frame occurs.
acceptance_criteria: Given the first 50 Hz frame, when it occurs, then the Mission Elapsed Time is zero.
Given later 50 Hz frames, when they occur, then initialization to zero is not repeated.

requirement_text: The system shall offer automation tools and workflows to streamline tasks, engage leads, and nurture customer relationships.
rationale: "Streamline tasks", "engage leads" and "nurture relationships" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: Which automation tools and workflows are required?
How is "engaging leads" or "nurturing relationships" measured?

requirement_text: User shall search for articles on the Online Journal Website by author name, category, or keyword.
user_story: As a reader, I want to search articles on the Online Journal Website by author name, category or keyword, so that I find relevant articles.
technical_task: Add an article search by author name, category and keyword.
acceptance_criteria: Given an author name, when the user searches, then articles by that author are shown.
Given a category or a keyword, when the user searches, then matching articles are shown.

requirement_text: System shall prioritize performance and scalability in managing large datasets and complex record structures.
rationale: "Prioritize performance and scalability" has no measurable target.
clarification_questions: What performance and scalability targets apply to large datasets and complex records?

requirement_text: For example selecting "Detailed" from the 'Established Patient' drop-down adds the associated CPT code to the list.
requirement_text_raw: For example  selecting "Detailed" from the 'Established Patient' drop-down adds the associated CPT code to the list.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want selecting Detailed from the Established Patient drop-down to add the associated CPT code to the list, so that the right code is billed.
technical_task: Add the CPT code linked to a selected option, such as Detailed in the Established Patient drop-down, to the list.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Established Patient drop-down, when the user selects Detailed, then the associated CPT code is added to the list.
Given another option in the drop-down, when the user selects it, then its associated CPT code is added to the list.
rationale: Role assumed: billing clerk. "For example" means other options behave alike.

requirement_text: CNG shall support mechanisms allowing the CNDs remote management when applicable.
user_story: As a network operator, I want the CNG to support mechanisms for remote management of the CNDs where applicable, so that I can manage devices remotely.
technical_task: Support remote management mechanisms in the CNG for the CNDs when remote management applies.
acceptance_criteria: Given a CND for which remote management applies, when the operator manages it remotely, then the CNG supports the management.
Given a CND for which remote management does not apply, when the operator tries to manage it remotely, then the CNG does not need to support it.

requirement_text: Patients can also be billed and their payments recorded.
requirement_text_raw: Patients can also be billed  and their payments recorded.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want to bill patients and record their payments, so that accounts are accurate.
technical_task: Provide billing of patients and recording of their payments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with a charge, when the clerk bills the patient, then the bill is created.
Given a bill, when the patient pays, then the payment is recorded.

requirement_text: The FTSS shall provide an API call to retrieve the current minor frame number sent from the FCP over the VME interface. Note that the NEFU ICP will not have this information since it does not have an FCP processor.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS shall [SRS231] provide an API call to retrieve the current minor frame number sent from the FCP over the VME interface.  Note that the NEFU ICP will not have this information since it does not have an FCP processor.
user_story: As an application developer, I want an FTSS API call to get the current minor frame number sent from the FCP over the VME interface, so that my application knows the frame.
technical_task: Provide an FTSS API call that returns the current minor frame number sent from the FCP over the VME interface.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FCP sends the minor frame number over the VME interface, when an application calls the API, then the current minor frame number is returned.
Given the NEFU ICP, when the API is called, then the minor frame number is not available because it has no FCP processor.

requirement_text: If an assistant is used to enter data that will subsequently be signed by a provider retain the date or time or use stamp of the data entry person as well as the provider.
requirement_text_raw: If an assistant is used to enter data that will subsequently be signed by a provider  retain the date or time or use stamp of the data entry person as well as the provider.
user_story: As an auditor, I want the date, time or user stamp of the data entry person kept as well as the provider's when an assistant enters data that a provider signs, so that both are traceable.
technical_task: Retain the date, time or user stamp of both the data entry person and the provider when an assistant enters data that is later signed by a provider.
acceptance_criteria: Given an assistant enters data that will be signed by a provider, when it is saved, then the stamp of the data entry person is retained.
Given the provider signs the data, when it is signed, then the stamp of the provider is retained as well.

requirement_text: The system shall prompt users to take breaks based on predefined settings or usage patterns.
user_story: As a user, I want prompts to take breaks based on predefined settings or usage patterns, so that I don't overuse the app.
technical_task: Prompt users to take breaks according to predefined settings or usage patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Given a predefined break setting, when its condition is met, then the user is prompted to take a break.
Given a usage pattern that calls for a break, when it is detected, then the user is prompted to take a break.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The settings are not described.

requirement_text: The EHR System will need to be able to track the changes as well as accommodate moving visit information (e.g. an account) from one medical record to another with associated audit trails.
requirement_text_raw: The EHR System will need to be able to track the changes as well as accommodate moving visit information (e.g.  an account) from one medical record to another with associated audit trails.
user_story: As a records manager, I want the EHR System to track changes and allow moving visit information from one medical record to another with audit trails, so that moves are traceable.
technical_task: Track changes to records and support moving visit information (for example an account) between medical records, with associated audit trails.
acceptance_criteria: Given a change to a record, when it is made, then the change is tracked.
Given visit information in one medical record, when it is moved to another, then an associated audit trail records the move.

requirement_text: Administration interfaces require strong authentication and authorization.
user_story: As a security officer, I want administration interfaces to require strong authentication and authorization, so that only legitimate administrators can use them.
technical_task: Require strong authentication and authorization for every administration interface.
acceptance_criteria: Given an administration interface, when a user opens it, then strong authentication and authorization are required.
Given a user who fails authentication or authorization, when the user opens an administration interface, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. "Strong" is not defined.

requirement_text: The iTrust user (admin) has been authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system (UC3).
user_story: As an administrator, I want to be authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system, so that I can work in it (UC3).
technical_task: Require the iTrust admin to be authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system.
acceptance_criteria: Given an admin with valid credentials, when the admin logs in, then the admin is authenticated.
Given an admin without valid credentials, when the admin logs in, then authentication fails.
rationale: Role stated: admin. The sentence states a precondition of use case UC3.

requirement_text: The system shall allow faculty to upload course materials (syllabus, lesson plans, notes, etc.) and question banks.
user_story: As a faculty member, I want to upload course materials, such as syllabus, lesson plans and notes, and question banks, so that students can use them.
technical_task: Provide upload of course materials and question banks for faculty.
acceptance_criteria: Given a faculty member, when the faculty member uploads a course material, then it is saved.
Given a faculty member, when the faculty member uploads a question bank, then it is saved.
rationale: Role stated: faculty. "Etc." means other material types may exist.

requirement_text: The system shall give the mediator privileges to schedule location and equipment resources.
user_story: As a mediator, I want privileges to schedule location and equipment resources, so that I can arrange meetings.
technical_task: Give the mediator the privilege to schedule location and equipment resources.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mediator, when the mediator schedules a location or equipment resource, then the booking is saved.
Given a user who is not a mediator, when the user tries to schedule these resources, then it is refused.
rationale: Role stated: mediator. The second criterion follows from "privileges".

requirement_text: Synchronous message passing sockets shall queue outgoing messages until they are transmitted at frame boundaries. The "create" and "open" API calls for synchronous sockets allow the application to specify the maximum message size and how many incoming messages the socket may buffer.
requirement_text_raw: 1.     Synchronous message passing sockets shall [SRS055] queue outgoing messages until they are transmitted at frame boundaries. The "create" and "open" API calls for synchronous sockets allow the application to specify the maximum message size and how many incoming messages the socket may buffer.
user_story: As an application developer, I want synchronous sockets to queue outgoing messages until frame boundaries, with create and open calls that set the maximum message size and incoming buffer count, so that messages are handled predictably.
technical_task: Queue outgoing messages on synchronous message passing sockets until they are transmitted at frame boundaries, and let the create and open API calls set the maximum message size and the number of incoming messages the socket may buffer.
acceptance_criteria: Given an outgoing message on a synchronous socket, when it is sent, then it is queued until it is transmitted at a frame boundary.
Given the create or open API call for a synchronous socket, when the application calls it, then it can specify the maximum message size and how many incoming messages the socket may buffer.

requirement_text: Cookies with sensitive data (e.g. authentication cookies) are encrypted.
user_story: As a security officer, I want cookies with sensitive data, such as authentication cookies, encrypted, so that they cannot be read.
technical_task: Encrypt every cookie that holds sensitive data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a cookie with sensitive data, when it is created, then it is encrypted.
Given an authentication cookie, when it is stored, then it is encrypted.

requirement_text: The system shall allow the mediator to negotiate a location / equipment.
user_story: As a mediator, I want to negotiate a location or equipment, so that resources are agreed.
technical_task: Support negotiation of a location or equipment by the mediator.
acceptance_criteria: Given a location or equipment resource, when the mediator negotiates it, then the negotiation is recorded.
Given a negotiated resource, when the mediator concludes, then the outcome is saved.
rationale: Role stated: mediator. How negotiation works is not described.

requirement_text: The re-align function shall write the voted value from the good channels into the target channel.
requirement_text_raw: The re-align function shall (3.3.8.12) write the voted value from the good channels into the target channel.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the re-align function to write the voted value from the good channels into the target channel, so that the target matches the good channels.
technical_task: Have the re-align function copy the voted value of the good channels into the target channel.
acceptance_criteria: Given good channels and a target channel, when the re-align function runs, then the voted value from the good channels is written into the target channel.
Given the re-align function has run, when the target channel is read, then it holds the voted value.

requirement_text: The system performance shall be responsive for uploading, searching, and downloading files.
clarification_questions: What response times count as "responsive" for uploading, searching and downloading files?

requirement_text: User shall have access to continuous performance monitoring and profiling to identify and address performance bottlenecks proactively, ensuring optimal system efficiency.
user_story: As an administrator, I want continuous performance monitoring and profiling, so that I can find and fix performance bottlenecks early.
technical_task: Run continuous performance monitoring and profiling that identifies performance bottlenecks.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system is running, when performance is monitored, then it is monitored continuously.
Given a performance bottleneck, when profiling runs, then the bottleneck is identified.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. "Optimal efficiency" is not measured.

requirement_text: The ASPERA-3 and MEX OA telemetry data shall be stored on a local SwRI archive.
user_story: As a mission scientist, I want the ASPERA-3 and MEX OA telemetry data stored on a local SwRI archive, so that it is kept at SwRI.
technical_task: Store the ASPERA-3 and MEX OA telemetry data in a local SwRI archive.
acceptance_criteria: Given ASPERA-3 telemetry data, when it is stored, then it is stored on the local SwRI archive.
Given MEX OA telemetry data, when it is stored, then it is stored on the local SwRI archive.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to handle 1000 customers logged in concurrently at the same time.
user_story: As an operations manager, I want the system to handle 1000 customers logged in at the same time, so that peak usage is covered.
technical_task: Support 1000 simultaneous logged-in customers.
acceptance_criteria: Given 1000 customers logged in at the same time, when they use the system, then it handles them.
Given fewer customers logged in, when they use the system, then it handles them.

requirement_text: User shall access the discussion forum section.
user_story: As a user, I want to access the discussion forum section, so that I can read and join discussions.
technical_task: Provide access to a discussion forum section.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application, when the user opens the discussion forum section, then it is displayed.
Given the discussion forum section, when the user views it, then the discussions are listed.

requirement_text: System shall design components with simplicity to avoid complexity, thereby enhancing overall performance.
rationale: "Simplicity" and "enhancing overall performance" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: What does "simplicity" and "complexity" mean in measurable terms for components?

requirement_text: From the time that the NE failure has been identified, and the NE is recoverable, to the time the NE is recovered shall be no more than 1.5 minutes.
requirement_text_raw: From the time that the NE failure has been identified, and the NE is recoverable, to the time the NE is recovered shall (3.1.11) be no more than 1.5 minutes.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want a recoverable failed NE recovered within 1.5 minutes of its failure being identified, so that capacity returns quickly.
technical_task: Complete recovery of a recoverable NE within 1.5 minutes of identifying its failure.
acceptance_criteria: Given an NE failure has been identified and the NE is recoverable, when recovery runs, then the NE is recovered within 1.5 minutes.
Given a recovery that takes longer than 1.5 minutes, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: System shall maintain uptime as per defined expectations and handle errors effectively.
rationale: The uptime expectations are not given and "effectively" is not measurable.
clarification_questions: What are the "defined expectations" for uptime?

requirement_text: The system shall present information on the screen in a user-friendly way using short sentences, clear sections, and bullet points for easy reading and understanding.
user_story: As a user, I want information shown with short sentences, clear sections and bullet points, so that it is easy to read and understand.
technical_task: Format on-screen information with short sentences, clearly separated sections and bullet points.
acceptance_criteria: Given information displayed on a screen, when it is presented, then it uses short sentences.
Given information displayed on a screen, when it is presented, then it is divided into clear sections and uses bullet points where lists occur.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Short" is not quantified.

requirement_text: The MET shall measure real-time from this event with an accuracy of at most 50 Parts Per Million (PPM).
requirement_text_raw: The MET shall (3.3.10.6) measure real-time from this event with an accuracy of at most 50 Parts Per Million (PPM).
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the MET to measure real time from this event with an accuracy of at most 50 Parts Per Million (PPM), so that timing is precise.
technical_task: Measure real time from the event in the MET with an error of no more than 50 PPM.
acceptance_criteria: Given the event has occurred, when the MET measures real time from it, then the accuracy is at most 50 PPM.
Given a measured error above 50 PPM, when it is evaluated, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. "This event" is not identified in the sentence.

requirement_text: System shall load thermostat definitions from initialization data.
user_story: As a building manager, I want the system to load the thermostat definitions from initialization data, so that thermostats are known at start.
technical_task: At start, read the thermostat definitions from the initialization data.
acceptance_criteria: Given initialization data with thermostat definitions, when the system starts, then it loads them.
Given a thermostat defined in the initialization data, when the system runs, then it is known to the system.
